Litany: "Let us ask..." [Khndresgook]. Prayer: "To Your all-powerful and wondrous resurrection."
And then, having placed the holy cross and the Gospel upon the book-stand, everyone shall prostrate; and the others, forming a choir, shall sing the Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 2nd Plagal [bk], "Your Cross, O Christ," according to the upper rule. But here [they say]: "And Your holy burial we magnify, and Your holy resurrection we glorify." Likewise: "Glory to Your holy cross, Alleluia; to Your holy burial, Alleluia; to Your holy resurrection, Alleluia," and so on according to the rule. And coming two by two, they shall kiss the holy cross and the Gospel, and say to one another: "Christ is risen from the dead!" [and the other replies]: "Blessed is the resurrection of Christ!" After that, Litany: "By the Holy Cross" [Soorp Khachivs]. Prayer: "Guardian" [Pahpanich].

Midday Introit: "Christ is risen." This is the Introit for this week. Verse: "Praise [the Lord], O Jerusalem." Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 1st Plagal [ak]: "Christ is risen from the dead."
Today begin the Psalter from "Blessed is the man..." [Yraneal eh], and every day say three sections [vokh], so that until the Coming of the Holy Spirit [Pentecost], eight canons may be completed; except for the eight canticles [awrhnootiunk] which are not of David.

Midday Psalm, first section: "Blessed is the man..." [Psalm 1]. "Why do the heathen rage..." [Psalm 2]. "Lord, how are they increased..." [Psalm 3].
Acts of the Apostles 1:15 to verse 26: "with the eleven apostles."
Alleluia. Psalm 147:12 [147] sung with tone; say in full: "Praise [the Lord], O Jerusalem."
Gospel according to Mark 16:2 to verse 8: "for they were afraid."
Eucharistic Song [Serbasatsootiun]: "Who is like the Lord..." This is the Eucharistic Song during the days of Fifty [Yinink].

But if you wish to perform the presentation [of the Gifts] by transferring [the elements], place the holy Sacrament upon another altar.
And when the priest says, "May the Lord God bless all," you say the Psalm-verse and the Eucharistic Song of the day beforehand with vigor; likewise also, "Let none of the catechumens..." and "The Body of the Lord..."
Then going to that altar where the holy Sacrament is, the deacons shall cry out in a loud voice: "He set His tabernacle in the sun."
The clerks [scribes] shall sing: "And He comes forth as a bridegroom."
Then the deacons, forming a choir, shall sing in a sweet voice: "We who mystically represent the cherubim..." and so on according to the rule.

In the tenth hour, having assembled in the church, they shall begin Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to You."
Acts 1:1 to verse 8: "to the ends of the earth."
Alleluia. "Arise, [O Lord]..."
Gospel according to Luke 24:13 to verse 36: "in the breaking of bread."
And they shall go out with the cross, the Gospel, censers, candles, and all decorations in procession, singing the Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 4th Plagal [dz]: "Today our Passover [Zatik]."
After that: "Stand [firm]" [Awrtee].
Gospel according to John 20:1 to verse 18: "and that He had spoken these things to her."
And they shall begin the Hymn of Rest [Sharakan Hangstean] Tone 1st [ad]: "O Ineffable Dispensation."
After that, Psalm 129 [130] sung with tone: "Out of the depths I cry."
Gospel according to John 5:24: "Truly, truly, I say to you," to verse 30: "who sent Me."
Hymn [Sharakan] Tone 1st [ad]: "The Holy Cross is our helper."
Psalm 4:6 [4]: "There has been signed..." Verse: "When I call..."
Gospel according to John 19:31: "The Jews therefore..." to verse 37: "whom they pierced."
And they shall bless the four corners of the world [Antastan].
Litany: "By the Holy Cross" [Soorp Khachivs]. Prayer: "Guardian" [Pahpanich].
After that, the deacon shall proclaim: "And again [in peace]..." Blessing and...
And then: "Incline [Your ear]" [Khonarhytso] and "Live" [Apretson].
Messedi: "The Lord is powerful." "The earth is the Lord's."
Hymn at Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 1st [ad]: "At the dawning..."
Dismissal Psalm 147:12 [147] sung with tone: "Praise [the Lord], O Jerusalem."
Gospel according to John 20:19: "Then the same day at evening..." to verse 25: "I will not believe."
Litany: "Let us ask..." [Khndresgook]. "Save [us]" [Ketso].
Prayer: "O King of Peace."

Monday is for the Deceased [Merelots]. On this week, say the Canticle [Awrhnootiun] of the Resurrection "The Lord from the heavens" in the tone of the day, then [the Hymn] of the Coming of the Holy Spirit, and so on according to the rule: Tone 1st [ad] / Tone 1st Plagal [ak]: "You were sent from the Father."
Patristic Hymn of Rest [Harts Hangstean], Tone 1st [ad]: "Blessed are You..." with its proper verses.
And all else is of the Resurrection.
Litany: "Let us say..." [Asasgook].
In the Morning:
Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to You."
Gospel according to Luke 24:1 to verse 12: "what was come to pass."
Litany: "Let us ask..." [Khndresgook]. "Save [us]" [Ketso].
Prayer: "To Your all-powerful and wondrous..."
